role: The client's packet handler for the play state: builds and updates the WorldClient's entities and chunks from server packets, applies player state (health, position, respawn, windows, effects) to the client player, and drives sounds, particles and GUI screens.

notes: Verified by csrc/tests/test_clientworld.c against the oracle's ClientWorldProbe recordings (out/java/clientworld/smoke-s1, walk300-s1, walk300-s42): entity spawn/move/teleport/destroy packets, chunk data, digests d.cw/d.cseed/d.cmath/d.cstat, and negative checks (S15-for-S17, skipped torch draw). Player-state packets are exercised by the survival tape snapshots (flow-walk-s1 and friends). lane/idxclient: the handlers checked one by one; four gaps remain (the note particle, a zombie's door crack, the S35 and S1C one-tick reads), each in missing. lane/idxclient (later): the gaps closed. handleEntityMetadata: each copy keeps watcher 16, the flag byte and its kind's values (the creeper's state, power and ignition, the enderman's block and scream, the zombie's child, villager and converting flags) from the S0F and every S1C the tracker sends when one changes (combat.c copy_kindw), and the renderer reads them (idx-watch-s1: the fleece stays on the sheared sheep at 31 and 32 as Java has it; idx-burn-s1: a zombie into lava and a creeper's swell, every tick); the player's own flag byte reaches it by PK_S1C_FLAGS and its health by the tracker pass's S1C, a plain watcher write. handleUpdateTileEntity: the plant a pot takes lands with its block, so the frame of the planting shows it as Java does (idx-pot-s1 84 and 85 within 17 px); a placed skull's S35 rides the same PlayerInstance flush. handleBlockAction's note particle: BlockNote.onBlockEventReceived's spawnParticle("note") goes through RenderGlobal.doSpawnParticle, which returns null for every name but the explosions and the firework spark when particleSetting is over 1 (RenderGlobal.java:2083-2120), and the oracle's options.txt pins particles:2 (Main.java particles, optionsFor), so nothing is drawn and the call draws no Random. handleChat: GuiNewChat's line from the S02's parts (idx-deathmsg-s1, idx-hudfx-s1).
